coordinates.geometry: axisymmetric (r,z); uniform node-centred mesh over the channel bounding box; plasma region = union of cells inside the wall at the cell's lower-z edge (exact straight bore, one-cell stair-step cone)
coordinates.particle_velocity_frame: meridional (v_r, v_theta, v_z) rotated back after a Cartesian advance

equations.relation: sum_e C_e (phi_n - phi_m) = Q_n * V_geom/V_shape + Q_surface_n, with C = eps0 * face_area / edge_length per plasma cell (B_r,z faces); axis regularity from the half-cell control volume (4 (phi_1-phi_0)/dr^2)
equations.verification: manufactured solution: observed order 1.999 over 8->16->32->64 radial cells; direct == dense == PCG; discrete Gauss law with electrode induced charge to 1e-9

equations.relation: Q_n = sum_p q W S_n(r_p,z_p) with bilinear S; fixed-point 2^-40 integer accumulation (order independent); rho_n = Q_n / V_shape (uniform density -> uniform rho, axis included)
equations.verification: global charge conservation, order independence, deposition/gather adjointness, uniform-density axis test

equations.relation: E = -grad(phi): central differences on plasma nodes, second-order one-sided at electrodes/walls, E_r = 0 on the axis

u=gamma v; u- = u + qE dt/2m; t = q dt B/(2 m gamma-); s = 2t/(1+t.t); u' = u- + u- x t; u+ = u- + u' x s; u_new = u+ + qE dt/2m; operation order identical to cft_revival.orbit_mc.integrator.relativistic_boris_push
equations.verification: 8-ulp agreement with orbit_mc push; speed preserved in pure B to 1e-13; uniform-field orbit vs orbit_mc <= 1e-6 gyroradii over 3000-4000 steps; E x B drift to 6e-3

equations.relation: x^n, v^(n-1/2): deposit(x^n) -> phi^n -> push v^(n+1/2) -> x^(n+1) -> boundaries -> MCC -> injection
equations.verification: single-electron kinetic energy conserved to < 1e-9 in pure B over 500 steps; open-system ledger residual reported

equations.relation: absorbed charge deposited on plasma-side wall nodes with renormalised bilinear weights; enters the Gauss law directly; zero field in the dielectric backing
equations.verification: surface deposit conserves charge and touches only wall nodes; Gauss law with surface charge

equations.relation: P_coll = 1 - exp(-nu_max dt) with nu_max = n_g max_E sum_k sigma_k v; process selection by cumulative nu_k/nu_max; elastic isotropic, excitation loses 8.32 eV, ionisation loses 12.13 eV with Vahedi-Surendra secondary energy (B = 8.7 eV)
equations.verification: per-process Bernoulli rates within 4 sigma of n_g sigma v dt at 40 eV on 4e5 electrons; kinematic energy bookkeeping; deterministic seed replay; CPU/GPU chi-square agreement

prescribed_magnetic_field.source: qualified P2 divergent-exit A_phi checkpoint bound by file/payload/mesh/run/sidecar SHA-256 (modern/spec/pic2d/p2-field-authority-v1.json)
prescribed_magnetic_field.interpolation: regular psi grid (dr 0.125 mm, dz 0.25 mm over the channel bounding box) -> orbit_mc PsiBicubicField (g = (psi - psi_axis)/r^2) -> node samples of (B_r, B_z) -> bilinear particle gather
prescribed_magnetic_field.verification: node samples equal the bicubic field exactly; bilinear error second order; collisionless electron orbit converges to orbit_mc as O(dx^2) (error ratio > 2.5 per refinement); primary vs refined psi grid differ by 0.25% of max |B|

stability_gates.cell_debye_ratio: max(dr,dz)/lambda_D(reference) <= configured limit (1.0 default; 2.0 for the coarse screening case)
stability_gates.particle_courant: v_max(max electron energy) dt / min(dr,dz) <= 1; any particle crossing more than one cell fails closed at runtime
stability_gates.poisson: recomputed true residual <= relative_tolerance * |rhs| on every solve

backends.cpu: numpy reference; bitwise deterministic; checkpoint/resume bitwise
backends.warp: CPU or CUDA; bit-identical fixed-point deposition; roundoff-level push (FMA contraction); host block-Thomas field solve shared with the CPU backend (identical phi); counter-based RNG seeded by (seed, step, stream): deterministic and checkpoint-resumable bitwise; ledger energies via float64 atomics (roundoff-level run-to-run)
backends.gpu_pcg: device Jacobi-PCG with deterministic reductions and CUDA graphs available via PoissonConfig2D(method='pcg'); verified against the direct solve to 1e-8 relative
backends.gpu_device_direct_v1_1: device block-Thomas solve (PoissonConfig2D(method='device-direct')), host sync every device_sync_steps, tile-reduced kernels, ion subcycling and electrode-work ledger: see modern/spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v1.1.json
backends.steady_state_runner_v1_2: operating point sized from measured kinetics, detached checkpointed resumable single-case runner with a plateau criterion; Simulation.load_state re-bases the interval bookkeeping: see modern/spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v1.2.json
backends.neutral_inventory_v1_3: quasi-steady 0-D neutral inventory (prescribed feed, measured ionisation sink, exit-plane effusion, artificial relaxation with exact atom ledgers; MCC real-collision frequency scaled by n_g/n_g0 under a fixed null ceiling; n_g in checkpoints, series, status and the plateau rule; runner finalize command): see modern/spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v1.3.json
backends.recycling_gates_graph_v1_4: wall-ion recycling in the neutral inventory (fifth ledger, gross/net utilisation, relaxation as an explicit option), fail-closed peak-node Debye gate and grid-heating triad, CUDA-graph replay of the whole step (bitwise vs direct launches), Bohm-scattering and SEE-scaffold sensitivity hooks default OFF: see modern/spec/pic2d/pic2d-model-v1.4.json

artifacts.canonical_json: sorted, compact, finite JSON + .sha256.json sidecar (byte and semantic SHA-256)
artifacts.checkpoint: cft.pic2d.checkpoint.v1: arrays npz bound by hash; config/field/cross-section/code identities required on reload

claim_boundary: development/screening numerics; not a validated or preregistered CFT prediction
no experimental comparison; no performance metric is derivable from these outputs
static uniform neutral background, no ion-neutral collisions, no secondary emission, Dirichlet exit plane, prescribed B
momentum-conserving scheme: energy is not exactly conserved; the ledger residual is reported, not hidden (v1.1 adds the electrode-work term so the residual no longer contains the supply work)
